items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring. Previously doubtful after limited Friday practice following DNPs.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated in Week 1; missed most practices.
items.implication: Ravens WR room depleted (Lane already IR); targets to Bateman, Andrews, Walker, Wester, Sarratt.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining BAL pass-catchers, especially Mark Andrews and Rashod Bateman.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT for Sunday vs Patriots with foot injury.
items.why: Foot injury; LP-DNP-DNP practice week.
items.implication: PIT WR targets shift to DK Metcalf and others; Levitan noted interest in extended look at Germie Bernard.
items.opportunity: Increased snap/target share for Metcalf and secondary PIT WRs.

items.text: Nico Collins ruled OUT (hamstring) for Week 2 vs Bengals after missing practices; confirmed across reports.
items.why: Hamstring suffered in Wednesday practice; history of multi-game absences.
items.implication: HOU WR volume to Hutchinson, Boutte, Noel; Schultz TE1 upside. Stroud less efficient.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets freer for secondary HOU WRs and Dalton Schultz; red-zone opportunities open.

items.text: TE Brock Bowers doubtful for Sunday; Raiders elevated TE Chris Myarick and WR Cody White from practice squad.
items.why: Knee; limited Friday, will test pregame but expected out or limited.
items.implication: LV TE vacuum; Michael Mayer or elevated options for volume. Jeanty/others less checkdowns?
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to other Raiders pass-catchers if OUT.

items.text: Puka Nacua will not practice Saturday (hip/groin soreness post-Thursday); listed questionable and likely MNF pregame decision vs Giants. Not related to camp psoas.
items.why: Hip/groin soreness after Thursday practice; second straight DNP day.
items.implication: If misses, heavier TE (Ferguson/Parkinson) and WR bump to Mumpfield (Whittington doubtful). Have pivot ready.
items.opportunity: If OUT: TE/WR role expansion in LAR offense.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury on the slate; affects Herbert and many projections. Limited Friday after DNPs; Q and 4pm ET game. Monitor closely.
items.why: Ribs from Week 1; biggest slate impact per Levitan data/projections.
items.implication: If OUT, Quentin Johnston and others surge; Herbert ceiling down. Game-time.
items.opportunity: If OUT: boosted routes/targets for Johnston and LAC pass-catchers.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN for 2026 debut. Patriots desperate for playmakers (AJ Brown IR); potential 10+ touches vs Stevenson. Nice upcoming schedule.
items.why: Ready to go per reports; NE needs explosives; matchups favorable pre-bye.
items.implication: Committee with Stevenson but high touch upside in debut; monitor split.
items.opportunity: Carries, routes, explosive plays possible in expanded role.

items.text: Alvin Kamara expected/IN; Travis Etienne Week 1 reduced workload concerning and further squeezed (hate list). Kamara return creates committee risk for Etienne.
items.why: Etienne matched Miller rushes Week 1, air-heavy; Kamara back squeezes passing role; underdog script.
items.implication: Etienne downgrade; Kamara flex/RB2 with unknown split (Miller also involved).
items.opportunity: Kamara goal-line/third-down potential; Etienne early-down residual.

items.text: Joe Burrow listed Q (back) but 'good to go' per reports; Bengals elevated Josh Johnson as precaution. Expected to play vs Texans.
items.why: Coach/Taylor indications positive; Burrow dismissive of missing.
items.implication: CIN offense full strength preferred; Chase/Higgins safe if plays.
items.opportunity: Full snap share if active; monitor inactives.

items.text: Giving Christian McCaffrey a bump off Week 1 usage regardless; Kaelon Black (groin) status still matters for SF backfield.
items.why: Week 1 usage strong; Black Q impacts handcuff/committee.
items.implication: CMC RB1 locked; monitor Black for any volume drip.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry/target floor elevated.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: 21/24 RB touches (74% snaps) through 3Q Week 1, 40% target share (tied lead), 24%+ util. Indy gave up big to Henry. Massive season range.
items.why: Elite Week 1 usage/target share in new offense; soft matchup.
items.implication: RB1 upside; start confidently. 10 Facts: 24% tgt share career high-ish.
items.opportunity: High snap, target, carry, RZ share confirmed.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE: 99 utilization Week 1 (tied Bijan lead), 19% target share last 10, 25+ touches frequent. Quietly strong passing role under Kubiak @ LAC.
items.why: Elite util score and consistent target share; favorable matchup.
items.implication: RB1/2 lock; overreaction to prior injury scare.
items.opportunity: High touches, routes, target share.

items.text: Justin Jefferson LOVE @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz Week 1; 93 yds/18 PPG career avg with Wentz. Bears allowed big YPT last week.
items.why: Volume with Wentz (Murray OUT); soft secondary matchup.
items.implication: WR1 smash; Wentz start confirmed.
items.opportunity: High target share, routes with Wentz.

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE @ TEN: 27% tgt share, 13.7 aDOT (3 deep) Week 1. TEN allowed high catch rate/YPT; weak vs WR historically.
items.why: Strong aDOT/usage; favorable matchup after tough Week 1.
items.implication: WR2/3 bounceback start.
items.opportunity: Target share and deep routes.
